fields.name: MixPad S
fields.description: An all-in-one smart home control panel that combines a Zigbee gateway, smart switch, touchscreen interface, voice control, and multi-device automation in a single wall-mounted unit. It supports control of lighting, smart appliances, and scenes through touch, physical buttons, voice, and the ORVIBO Home app. The MixPad S also includes built-in temperature, humidity, light, and proximity sensing.
specs: Voice Control: Dual-Microphone Array, 7m Far-Field Recognition
Sensors: Temperature, Humidity, Ambient Light, Proximity

fields.name: MixPad M5
fields.description: A smart voice control panel that combines touch-based lighting control, voice assistance, and multi-protocol smart-home connectivity in a single wall-mounted interface. The MixPad M5 supports 4-gang lighting control, dimming and color adjustment, automation scenes, remote app control, and control of compatible curtains, air conditioners, and other smart devices.

fields.name: MixPad Genie
fields.description: A compact smart control panel designed to bring lighting, appliance control, and everyday smart-home functions into one interface. It combines a 3.27-inch HD touchscreen with physical buttons, voice/app control, and multiple wireless protocols, while also supporting Type-C phone charging. ORVIBO lists it as a smart panel for controlling lights and home appliances, with temperature, date, and time display.
specs: Power: Zero Live Wire, Two-Terminal Socket, or Data Line

fields.name: Smoke Sensor SF30
fields.description: A Zigbee smart smoke sensor designed to continuously monitor for smoke and provide an immediate audible and visual warning when smoke is detected. It can also send alerts through the ORVIBO smart-home app, supports remote mute, and provides low-battery warnings for continuous fire-safety monitoring.

fields.name: Water Leakage Sensor SW30
fields.description: A compact Zigbee smart water leakage sensor designed to detect water leaks, overflow, and changes in water levels before they cause significant damage. It provides a local light alarm and remote notifications through the ORVIBO smart-home ecosystem, making it suitable for bathrooms, kitchens, utility areas, and other locations where water leakage needs to be monitored. It uses low-power operation and tool-free placement for easy installation.
specs: Alarm: Local Light Alarm & Remote Push Notification
Installation: Direct Placement in Detection Area

fields.name: MixPad 7 Ultra
fields.description: An all-in-one multi-protocol smart home gateway and central control panel that combines a 7-inch touchscreen with Zigbee 3.0, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth connectivity. It provides centralized control of lighting and other smart-home devices, includes four built-in high-power lighting control outputs, infrared control for compatible appliances, voice interaction, and integrated stereo background audio.
specs: Maximum Load: 400W/loop for 1/2 loop; 200W/loop for 3/4 loop

fields.name: MixPad X
fields.description: A full-screen smart home control panel and multi-protocol gateway designed to centralize control of connected devices and smart-home scenes. It features a 12.3-inch panoramic touchscreen, built-in stereo speakers, voice control, and support for Zigbee, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and RS485, allowing it to coordinate lighting, appliances, and other smart-home devices from a single wall-mounted interface. ORVIBO states that it can connect up to 300 Zigbee devices and support thousands of devices through gateway cascading.
specs: Lighting Control: 2-Gang, Up to 600W per Circuit
Microphone: Four-Microphone Array, Up to 10m Far-Field Wake-up
Gateway Capacity: Up to 300 Zigbee Devices

fields.name: ZigBee Mini Hub
fields.description: A compact ZigBee smart home hub that connects and manages multiple ORVIBO ZigBee devices, allowing them to work together to create automated smart scenes. It connects to the HomeMate app through your network and serves as the central bridge for compatible sensors, switches, and other ZigBee devices. ORVIBO states that the Mini Hub can support up to 100 ZigBee devices.

fields.name: Multi-functional Relay Switch
fields.description: The ORVIBO Multi-functional Relay Switch enables compatible curtain motors and other supported devices to be integrated into a smart home system. Using Zigbee connectivity, it supports app-based control and automation through customised scenes.
specs: Function: Smart Control of Compatible Devices
Control Method: Smartphone App via Compatible Zigbee Hub

fields.name: MixSwitch Bach 8 Keys
fields.description: The ORVIBO MixSwitch Bach 8 Keys is an eight-gang Zigbee 3.0 smart wall switch designed to control up to eight lighting circuits. It supports local physical control and smart-home automation through an ORVIBO Zigbee gateway or compatible control panel. The switch uses a metal-button design and is suitable for LED, incandescent, and energy-saving lamps.
specs: Load Type: LED, Incandescent & Energy-Saving Lamps

fields.name: In Wall Switch
fields.description: A compact Zigbee smart switch module designed to upgrade traditional single-live mechanical wall switches into smart lighting controls. It fits inside a standard switch box and allows manual control through the existing switch as well as remote control, scheduling, and scene automation through the ORVIBO Home app when connected to a compatible Zigbee hub.

fields.name: Central A/C Control Panel
fields.description: A Zigbee smart control panel designed to upgrade compatible fan-coil central air-conditioning systems with local and smartphone control. Working with an ORVIBO Zigbee smart hub, it supports remote operation through the HomeMate app, scheduling, and adjustment of cooling, heating, and ventilation modes, with temperature settings from 10°C to 30°C.

fields.name: Door Sensor SM11
fields.description: A compact Zigbee-based magnetic door and window sensor designed to monitor whether an entry point is open or closed. The SM11 uses a two-part magnetic design and can send alerts when the sensor and magnet separate, enabling security notifications and smart-home automation when paired with an ORVIBO Zigbee hub.

fields.name: Smart Door Lock C1
fields.description: A Wi-Fi smart door lock that provides keyless entry through fingerprint, password, card, mechanical key, smartphone app, and NFC. It features Swedish FPC biometric fingerprint recognition, remote security alerts, anti-theft protection, and integration with the ORVIBO HomeMate ecosystem for smart-home automation. ORVIBO also specifies a battery life of over 400 days under its test conditions.
specs: Unlock Methods: Fingerprint, Password, Card, Mechanical Key, App, NFC
Fingerprint Sensor: Swedish FPC Biometric Sensor
Material: Aluminum Alloy, ABS & Tempered Glass

fields.name: Smart Door Lock S2
fields.description: A smart fingerprint door lock designed for keyless and connected entry, combining fingerprint recognition, password access, NFC/encrypted cards, remote authorization, and a mechanical key. The S2 connects via Wi-Fi for networked functions and includes multiple security alarms for low battery, tampering, emergency unlocking, and failed authentication. ORVIBO specifies compatibility with standard wooden and security doors and a 35–60 mm door thickness range.
specs: Unlock Methods: Fingerprint, Password, NFC Card, Encryption Card, Remote Authorization, Mechanical Key
Security: Low-Voltage, Pry, Emergency Unlock & Failed Authentication Alarms
Door Compatibility: Wooden & Security Doors, 35–60mm Thickness
Material: Zinc Alloy, Stainless Steel & Tempered Glass

fields.name: Smart IP Camera S1
fields.description: A 2K smart indoor IP camera designed for wide-area home monitoring with AI human detection, subject tracking, infrared night vision, abnormal-sound and crying detection, and two-way communication. Its pan-and-tilt design provides 360° horizontal and 210° vertical coverage, while dual-band Wi-Fi enables remote monitoring and smart-home security integration. ORVIBO also provides physical privacy shielding and supports local Micro SD or cloud storage.
specs: Night Vision: 10m IR HD + Low-Light Full-Color
Detection: AI Human Detection, Motion Tracking & Sound Detection
Storage: Micro SD up to 128GB & Cloud Storage

fields.name: Smart Lock V5 Face
fields.description: A fully automatic smart door lock that combines AI 3D facial recognition, fingerprint access, NFC, passwords, cards, remote authorization, and mechanical key entry. It features a built-in 1080P visual doorbell with a 165° wide-angle camera and a 4-inch IPS HD indoor display for visitor monitoring and two-way communication. The V5 Face also supports smart-home integration and automatic locking for a seamless, secure entry experience.
specs: Unlock Methods: 3D Face Recognition, Fingerprint, PIN, NFC, IC Card, App, MixPad, Mechanical Key
Power: 7.4V Rechargeable Lithium Battery / USB-C Emergency Power

fields.name: Temperature Humidity Sensor
fields.description: A compact Zigbee smart sensor that continuously monitors indoor temperature and humidity in real time. It can trigger smart-home automations based on environmental changes, such as adjusting an air conditioner or activating a humidifier, while providing low-battery warnings and app alerts. Its tool-free design allows flexible wall or tabletop placement.

fields.name: MixSwitch Bach 4 Keys
fields.description: The ORVIBO MixSwitch Bach 4 Keys is a premium four-gang Zigbee smart wall switch designed for controlling multiple lighting circuits while integrating with a smart-home system. It features a modular design with detachable buttons, customizable button names, and a metal-button finish. It supports Zigbee 3.0 communication and can control LED, incandescent, and energy-saving lamps.
specs: Load Type: LED, Incandescent & Energy-Saving Lamps

fields.name: MixSwitch 1
fields.description: The ORVIBO MixSwitch 1 is a one-gang Zigbee smart wall switch designed to control a single lighting circuit. It supports physical switching as well as smart-home automation through an ORVIBO Zigbee gateway, allowing lights to be controlled through scenes, schedules, sensors, and the app.
specs: Power Supply: Live Wire and Neutral Wire

fields.name: MixSwitch 2
fields.description: The ORVIBO MixSwitch 2 is a two-gang Zigbee 3.0 smart wall switch designed to control two separate lighting circuits. It combines traditional physical switching with smart-home control, allowing the switch to participate in automated scenes and control through the ORVIBO ecosystem. It is available in white, grey, and gold.
specs: Power Supply: Live Wire and Neutral Wire

fields.name: MixSwitch 3
fields.description: The ORVIBO MixSwitch 3 is a three-gang Zigbee smart wall switch designed to control three separate lighting circuits. It combines traditional physical switching with smart-home automation, allowing the switches to be integrated into scenes and controlled through the ORVIBO ecosystem. It is available in white, grey, and gold.
specs: Power Supply: Live Wire and Neutral Wire

fields.name: MixSwitch Defy 3
fields.description: The ORVIBO MixSwitch Defy 3 is a three-gang Zigbee 3.0 smart wall switch designed to independently control three lighting circuits. It combines physical button control with ORVIBO smart-home automation, allowing the switch to be integrated into smart scenes and other Zigbee devices. Its PC body with a spray-paint finish gives it a more premium appearance than a conventional wall switch.
specs: Installation: Wall Mount / Standard Wall Box

fields.name: MixSwitch Defy Smart Panel
fields.description: The ORVIBO MixSwitch Defy Smart Panel is an all-in-one smart wall control panel that combines lighting control, smart scenes, and a touchscreen interface. It features a 2.41-inch IPS touchscreen, customizable buttons, proximity sensing, voice interaction, and Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Zigbee 3.0 connectivity. It can control lighting circuits while also acting as an interface for broader smart-home automation.
specs: Control: Touch, App, Voice & Smart Scenes
Proximity Sensor: Built-in Active Proximity Sensor
Installation: Wall Mount / Standard Wall Box

fields.name: SOPRO Smart COB Strip Light S10
fields.description: The ORVIBO SOPRO Smart COB Strip Light S10 is a 5-metre smart LED strip designed to provide smooth, continuous lighting without the visible dots common in conventional LED strips. It supports adjustable brightness and colour temperature, from warm white to cool white, making it suitable for ceiling coves, cabinets, display shelves, bedrooms, and other decorative interior lighting. It integrates with compatible smart lighting controls for personalised scenes and ambience.
specs: Connectivity: Smart Control via Compatible Controller

fields.name: SOPRO Smart Grille Light S10
fields.description: The ORVIBO SOPRO Smart Grille Light S10 is a recessed smart LED light designed for precise, focused illumination in modern interiors. Its grille structure shields the exposed light source to reduce glare while delivering concentrated light for artwork, decorative walls, display areas, and architectural features. It supports Zigbee smart-home integration, dimming, and adjustable colour temperature. The series is available in 10W and 20W versions.
specs: Applications: Accent Lighting, Artwork & Decorative Walls

fields.name: Ultra-thin Smart Magnetic Grille Light S20
fields.description: The ORVIBO Ultra-thin Smart Magnetic Grille Light S20 is a slim magnetic-track LED fixture designed for focused accent lighting in modern residential and commercial spaces. Its grille design helps control light direction and reduce glare, making it suitable for highlighting artwork, display shelves, feature walls, and architectural details. The magnetic mounting system allows installation on a compatible track.
specs: Dimming: Adjustable Brightness and Color Temperature
Applications: Accent, Display and Architectural Lighting

fields.name: Ultra-thin Smart Magnetic Folding Grille Light S20
fields.description: The ORVIBO Ultra-thin Smart Magnetic Folding Grille Light S20 is a compact smart LED fixture featuring a folding grille design for directional accent lighting. Its adjustable structure helps direct light toward artwork, decorative features, and display areas, while its anti-glare optics provide concentrated illumination. The fixture attaches to a compatible 48V magnetic track and integrates with the ORVIBO smart-home ecosystem for dimming, colour-temperature adjustment, and lighting scenes.
specs: Dimming: Adjustable Brightness and Color Temperature
Control: App, Voice, Touchscreen and Smart Scenes

fields.name: Ultra-thin Smart Magnetic Spotlight S20
fields.description: The ORVIBO Ultra-thin Smart Magnetic Spotlight S20 is a slim LED spotlight designed for modern magnetic-track lighting systems. It provides focused illumination for accent lighting, artwork, display shelves, and architectural features. Its minimalist design integrates with compatible ORVIBO smart-home lighting controls, supporting adjustable brightness and colour temperature for customised lighting scenes.
specs: Control: App, Voice, Touchscreen and Smart Scenes

fields.name: Ultra-thin Magnetic Track Connector (I-type)
fields.description: The ORVIBO Ultra-thin Magnetic Track Connector (I-Type) is a straight connector designed to join two compatible magnetic lighting track sections end-to-end. It helps maintain a continuous track layout while providing a clean, low-profile finish that matches black magnetic track systems. It is suitable for residential and commercial lighting installations using compatible ORVIBO ultra-thin magnetic track components.
specs: Product Type: I-Type Straight Track Connector
Compatibility: ORVIBO Ultra-thin Magnetic Track System
Function: Connects Two Track Sections in a Straight Line
Electrical Function: Transfers Power Between Connected Tracks

fields.name: Ultra-thin Magnetic Track Rail 1.5m
fields.description: The ORVIBO Ultra-thin Magnetic Track Rail is a slim lighting track designed to support compatible magnetic smart lighting fixtures, including spotlights and grille lights. Its minimalist profile integrates neatly into modern ceilings, providing a flexible lighting system in which compatible fixtures can be attached and repositioned along the rail. The 1.5-metre length is suitable for residential and commercial applications such as living rooms, corridors, galleries, and retail displays.
specs: Product Type: Ultra-thin Magnetic Lighting Track
Compatibility: ORVIBO Ultra-thin Magnetic Track Lights

fields.name: Ultra-thin Magnetic Track Rail 0.5m
fields.description: The ORVIBO Ultra-thin Magnetic Track Rail is a compact 0.5-metre track designed to support compatible magnetic smart lighting fixtures. Its slim profile creates a clean, minimalist appearance while allowing magnetic spotlights and grille lights to be positioned along the track. It is suitable for smaller lighting sections, accent areas, display shelves, and modular ceiling lighting installations.
specs: Product Type: Ultra-thin Magnetic Lighting Track
Compatibility: ORVIBO Ultra-thin Magnetic Track Lights
Applications: Accent, Display and Architectural Lighting

fields.name: Ultra-thin Smart Magnetic Floodlight S20
fields.description: The ORVIBO Ultra-thin Smart Magnetic Floodlight S20 is a slim LED lighting fixture designed for compatible 48V magnetic-track systems. Its wide-angle illumination provides broad, even lighting for living rooms, corridors, retail displays, and other contemporary interiors. It integrates with the ORVIBO smart-lighting ecosystem, supporting adjustable brightness and colour temperature for customised lighting scenes.
specs: Control: App, Compatible Smart Panels and Smart Scenes

fields.name: Smart Door & Window Sensor
fields.description: The ORVIBO Smart Door & Window Sensor is a compact wireless security device that detects when a door or window is opened or closed. Its two-part magnetic design triggers alerts when the sensor separates from the magnet, helping homeowners monitor entry points remotely. It integrates with the ORVIBO HomeMate app and compatible Zigbee hubs, enabling smartphone notifications and automated actions such as switching on lights when a door opens. Installation is simple and requires no electrician.
specs: Communication Range: Up to 80m in Open Areas

fields.name: Smart Motion Sensor (PIR)
fields.description: The ORVIBO Smart Motion Sensor uses Passive Infrared (PIR) technology to detect movement within its coverage area. It connects to a compatible Zigbee hub, enabling motion alerts through the ORVIBO HomeMate app and automated actions such as switching on lights when someone enters a room. Its compact, battery-powered design allows flexible installation without additional electrical wiring, making it suitable for entrances, corridors, living rooms, and home security systems.
specs: Communication Range: Up to 80m in Open Areas
Hub Requirement: Compatible ORVIBO Zigbee Hub

fields.name: Smart Combustible Gas Sensor
fields.description: The ORVIBO Smart Combustible Gas Sensor is a smart safety device designed to detect natural gas (methane) leaks in indoor spaces, particularly kitchens and areas where gas appliances are used. When gas concentration reaches its alarm threshold, the sensor activates an audible and visual alarm and can send notifications through the ORVIBO HomeMate app when connected to a compatible Zigbee hub. It helps provide early warning of potentially dangerous gas leaks.
specs: Alarm Type: Audible and Visual Alarm
Wireless Range: Up to 80m in Open Areas

fields.name: Smart Emergency SOS Button
fields.description: The ORVIBO Smart Emergency SOS Button is a wireless emergency trigger designed to help users quickly request assistance with a single press. When connected to a compatible ORVIBO smart-home hub, it can trigger configured alerts or automation routines, making it useful for bedrooms, living areas, and homes where elderly people or individuals who may need urgent assistance live. Its compact design allows it to be placed within easy reach.
specs: Communication Range: Up to 80m in Open Areas
Installation: Tabletop or Adhesive Wall Mount

fields.name: Smart Outdoor Security Camera S3
fields.description: The ORVIBO Smart Outdoor Security Camera S3 is a weather-resistant security camera designed to monitor outdoor areas such as entrances, driveways, gardens, and business premises. It captures detailed 4MP footage and features AI human detection, full-colour night vision, and two-way audio for communicating with visitors remotely. Its IP66-rated housing protects against dust and water, while Wi-Fi connectivity and optional Power over Ethernet (PoE) support flexible installation. Video can be stored on a microSD card, in the cloud, or through a compatible NVR system.
specs: Detection: AI Human Detection and Motion Alerts
Weather Protection: IP66 Dust and Water Resistance
Storage: microSD up to 128GB, Cloud or NVR

fields.name: Indoor WiFi PTZ Camera
fields.description: The ORVIBO Indoor WiFi PTZ Camera is a smart indoor surveillance camera designed to monitor homes, offices, and other interior spaces. Its pan-tilt-zoom functionality allows users to adjust the viewing direction remotely, providing broader room coverage than a fixed camera. With Wi-Fi connectivity and app-based monitoring, it supports remote viewing, motion alerts, and convenient security monitoring through a compatible smart-home system.

fields.name: ArtisBox Play Smart Wall Speaker
fields.description: The ORVIBO ArtisBox Play Smart Wall Speaker is a wall-mounted smart audio device designed to deliver music and audio playback while complementing a modern smart-home interior. Its integrated design helps reduce countertop clutter and makes it suitable for living rooms, bedrooms, and entertainment areas. Depending on the model and compatible system, it can integrate with smart-home controls for convenient audio operation.
specs: Wireless Stereo: True Wireless Stereo (TWS) Pairing
Installation: Wall-Mounted or Floor-Mounted with Compatible Bracket

fields.name: Smart Tubular Motor (Roller Shutter)
fields.description: The ORVIBO Smart Tubular Motor is designed to automate roller blinds and shutters, allowing users to raise or lower window coverings conveniently. Integrated into a compatible smart-home system, it supports remote operation and automated schedules, helping manage privacy, daylight, and indoor comfort. It is suitable for residential and commercial spaces where motorised window coverings are required.
specs: Application: Roller Shutters and Motorised Blinds
Control: Compatible Smart Controller and Remote Control
Smart Integration: ORVIBO Smart Home Ecosystem
Automation: Scheduling and Smart Scenes, When Supported
Compatibility: Depends on Motor Diameter, Torque and Shutter Size

fields.name: Smart Ceiling Speaker Set (Master & Slave)
fields.description: The ORVIBO Smart Ceiling Speaker Set is a Bluetooth-enabled in-ceiling audio system consisting of one master speaker and one slave speaker. Designed to blend discreetly into modern interiors, it delivers music throughout living rooms, bedrooms, and entertainment spaces without occupying floor or shelf space. It supports wireless audio streaming from compatible phones and other Bluetooth devices and can integrate with compatible ORVIBO smart-home control panels for convenient audio playback.
specs: Smart Integration: Compatible ORVIBO MixPad Panels

fields.name: Smart Light Strip Controller (72W)
fields.description: The ORVIBO Smart Light Strip Controller (72W) is a smart lighting controller designed to operate compatible ORVIBO LED strip lights. It enables users to adjust brightness and colour temperature, create lighting scenes, and control strip lighting through the ORVIBO smart-home ecosystem. With Zigbee connectivity, it can integrate with compatible smart panels and hubs for app-based control, voice commands, and automated lighting routines. It is suitable for decorative lighting in ceiling coves, bedrooms, living rooms, and other indoor spaces.
specs: Control: ORVIBO App, Voice, Smart Panels and Scenes
Compatibility: Compatible ORVIBO Smart LED Strip Lights

fields.name: Zigbee LED Strip Light Controller (36W)
fields.description: The ORVIBO Zigbee LED Strip Light Controller (36W) enables smart control of compatible ORVIBO LED strip lights. Using Zigbee connectivity, it supports app-based lighting control and integration with compatible smart-home devices, allowing users to adjust lighting and incorporate it into scenes and automated routines. Its 36W capacity makes it suitable for compatible low-power LED strip installations.
specs: Control: Compatible ORVIBO App, Smart Panels and Scenes
Compatibility: Compatible ORVIBO LED Strip Lights

fields.name: Zigbee LED Strip Light Controller (120W)
fields.description: The ORVIBO Zigbee LED Strip Light Controller (120W) enables smart control of compatible ORVIBO LED strip lights. With Zigbee connectivity, it supports app-based control and integration with compatible smart-home devices, allowing users to adjust lighting, create scenes, and automate lighting routines. Its 120W capacity makes it suitable for larger LED strip installations within the controller’s supported electrical limits.
specs: Control: Compatible ORVIBO App and Smart-Home Devices
Compatibility: Compatible ORVIBO LED Strip Lights
Functions: Smart Lighting Control, Scenes and Automation

fields.name: Human Presence Sensor
fields.description: The ORVIBO Human Presence Sensor detects human presence and activity using 24GHz millimeter-wave radar technology. It can detect subtle movements and help automate compatible smart-home devices, such as turning lights on when someone enters a room. Through Zigbee connectivity, it integrates with compatible smart-home systems to support intelligent lighting and other automated routines.

Smart Home Integration: Compatible Zigbee System

fields.name: MixPad Genie / Rotating Screen G1
fields.description: The ORVIBO MixPad Genie Rotating Screen G1 is a smart home control panel designed to bring lighting and compatible home-device controls into one convenient interface. Its touchscreen and physical controls make it easier to manage smart devices and scenes, while supported connectivity enables integration with compatible smart-home systems. The system supports convenient communication between indoor and outdoor units.

Its slim profile makes it suitable for bedside areas, kitchen counters, dining spaces, and other locations requiring directional lighting. fields.description: The ORVIBO Smart Magnetic Round Chandelier S2 is a compact, circular smart light designed to provide wide, soft illumination in modern interiors. fields.name: Chinedu Okafor
fields.text: Easy to set up and it connected all my Zigbee devices quickly. Has been stable since installation.

fields.name: Adebayo Olumide
fields.text: Works well overall, but I had to restart it once during initial pairing. After that, it’s been fine.

fields.name: Ifeoma Nwosu
fields.text: Compact design is a plus and it doesn’t take space. Integration with my smart switches is smooth.

fields.name: Emeka Ugochukwu
fields.text: It gets the job done, but the setup process wasn’t very beginner-friendly. Took some trial and error.

fields.name: Oluwaseun Adeyemi
fields.text: Very reliable hub. My lights and sensors respond faster now compared to my old setup.

fields.name: Ngozi Chukwu
fields.text: Performance is solid, but I wish the app gave more detailed feedback during pairing.

fields.name: Daniel Olatunji
fields.text: Strong connectivity and no drops so far. It handles multiple devices without issues.

fields.name: Femi Adegbola
fields.text: Very solid central control panel. I like having lighting and security controls in one place.

fields.name: Chioma Umeh
fields.text: Works well and feels premium, but the interface took me a bit of time to understand fully.

fields.name: Suleiman Adamu
fields.text: Good device overall. It controls my smart home reliably, but setup wasn’t very straightforward.

fields.name: Kehinde Oladipo
fields.text: Not bad, but I expected faster response when switching between scenes.

fields.name: Ibrahim Danjuma
fields.text: Very reliable after setup. It has made controlling my home automation much easier.

fields.name: Aminu Garba
fields.text: Very good smart panel. It connects different devices easily and keeps everything in one control point.

fields.name: Ezinne Okechukwu
fields.text: Solid performance, but the interface took some time to get used to at first.

fields.name: Babatunde Salami
fields.text: Works fine overall, but I noticed slight delays when switching between complex scenes.

fields.name: Luca Bianchi
fields.text: Decent device, but I feel the price is a bit high for what it currently offers.

fields.name: Nkechi Omeh
fields.text: Loud alarm and fast detection. Gives peace of mind knowing it responds quickly to smoke.

fields.name: Aliyu Bashir
fields.text: Works well, but I tested it and the alarm is quite sensitive even to light smoke.

fields.name: Seun Adebiran
fields.text: Works fine, but battery life could be better based on my usage.

fields.name: Chiamaka Okoye
fields.text: Very helpful device. It detected a small kitchen leak early and saved me from damage.

fields.name: Yakubu Danjuma
fields.text: Works as expected, but sometimes takes a second or two before sending alerts.

fields.name: Grace Nkansah
fields.text: Reliable and simple to use. I placed it under my sink and it works perfectly.

fields.name: Ahmed Muhammadu
fields.text: The 7-inch display is clear and responsive, and having my lights and other devices accessible from one panel makes things much easier.

fields.name: Chukwudi Okafor
fields.text: Installation was straightforward and the interface is easy to understand. I particularly like being able to control different devices without switching between apps.

fields.name: Osagie Eghobamien
fields.text: The screen is good and the controls respond quickly. The audio is also better than I expected from a wall-mounted panel.

fields.name: Terna Iorfa
fields.text: It works well, but the interface took me some time to get used to. Once everything was set up, controlling the lights became much more convenient.

fields.name: Emily Carter
fields.text: A very capable smart-home panel. The centralised control is excellent, although I think the initial setup could be a little simpler.

fields.name: Nneka Eze
fields.text: The large screen makes controlling the different smart-home functions very convenient. It also looks excellent on the wall.

fields.name: Abdulrahman Sani
fields.text: The display is impressive and the controls are responsive. Setup took a little patience, but everything has been working reliably since.

fields.name: Efe Omoregie
fields.text: I like having so many controls in one place. The screen is particularly useful when managing multiple rooms and scenes.

fields.name: Chiamaka Nwosu
fields.text: Good smart panel with a premium feel. I had some trouble getting everything configured initially, but the performance has been solid.

fields.name: Daniel Mwangi
fields.text: The panel looks great and the large display is useful. It is quite expensive, though, especially compared with smaller control panels.

fields.name: Yusuf Abdullahi
fields.text: Small and easy to set up. It connects my Zigbee devices reliably and I haven't had any connection issues so far.

fields.name: Adaobi Nnamani
fields.text: It does exactly what I needed. My sensors and switches connect through it without any noticeable delays.

fields.name: Bright Akpan
fields.text: The hub is compact and works well with my other smart-home devices. Setup instructions could be clearer, though.

fields.name: Emeka Nwankwo
fields.text: The switch feels very solid and premium. The buttons have a nice tactile response, and controlling the lights remotely is convenient.

fields.name: Hauwa Ibrahim
fields.text: Clean design and easy to use once connected. It works well with my smart-home setup and the physical buttons still work perfectly.

fields.name: Rotimi Adekunle
fields.text: Good switch with a nice finish. The installation took longer than expected, but the smart controls have been reliable.

fields.name: Esosa Igbinovia
fields.text: The design is nice and it works as advertised, but I think the price is a little high for a smart switch.

fields.name: Sikirat Yusuf
fields.text: Very useful for upgrading my existing light switch without changing the whole setup. It responds quickly and has been reliable so far.

fields.name: Uchechukwu Obi
fields.text: Small enough to fit behind the switch and the installation was fairly straightforward. The remote control feature is what I like most.

fields.name: Mfoniso Etim
fields.text: Small, discreet, and works exactly as expected. I get an alert whenever the door is opened, which gives me extra peace of mind.

fields.name: Abdulbasit Musa
fields.text: The fingerprint unlock is fast and convenient. I rarely need to carry keys anymore, and the lock has been working reliably.

fields.name: Amarachi Eze
fields.text: I like having several ways to unlock the door, especially the fingerprint and password options. Setup was a little confusing at first.

fields.name: Kelechi Nwosu
fields.text: The lock feels sturdy and the security features are good. It is a bit expensive, but the convenience makes it worthwhile.

fields.name: Salihu Mohammed
fields.text: The image quality is clear, even at night, and the motion tracking works better than I expected. The app notifications are also useful.

fields.name: Eniola Balogun
fields.text: Good camera with a wide viewing angle. Setup was fairly easy, although the app took me a little while to get used to.

fields.name: Favour Osei
fields.text: Small sensor but very useful. The temperature and humidity readings have been consistent, and I like being able to check them remotely.

fields.name: Mustapha Lawal
fields.text: Easy to install and the readings are displayed clearly in the app. It has been working reliably since I set it up.

fields.name: Efe Ojo
fields.text: Does what it is supposed to do and doesn't take up much space. The battery has also lasted well so far.

fields.name: Chisom Nwafor
fields.text: The sensor is accurate enough for monitoring my room, although I would have preferred a display on the device itself.

fields.name: Terseer Aondofa
fields.text: Works well for basic temperature and humidity monitoring. The app setup was slightly confusing at first, but everything is fine now.
